notes.title: Version 3.1
notes.notes:
Some text errors have been fixed.
Graphics quality has been improved.
Sengoku's health has reached 75 million.
Emperor map has been added.
Tenctacle has been added.
Hiken has been added.
Emperors have been edited. (Allegiance oaths have been removed.)
Fleet towers' attack speed has been increased.
Battle pass has been edited.
Tortuga cooldown has been reduced from 15 minutes to 10 minutes.
1% gun damage has been added to medals.
A chest that can purchase old event designs has been added.
Seasonal ammo packs have been added.
Vice captains have been added.
Purple event has been added

notes.title: Version 3.0
notes.notes:
The cannonball attack system has been changed.
The interface has been edited.
The Eagle Eye Book and Tiger Claw Book have been added.
Some minor bugs have been fixed.
Cooldown has been added for entering PVE Raid.
New medal has been added.
Battle Pass has been added.
Material prices have been adjusted.
The ability to enable and disable ship and explosion effects has been added.
Dragon event has been added.
Emperors have been added.

notes.title: Version 2.9
notes.notes:
Added a blue name for players with all medals.
Fixed a bug where the Baron wouldn't spawn in the middle of the island.
Adjusted the point for elite classes.
Adjusted the appearance of elite classes.
Adjusted the King market.
Made some optimizations.
Added the Season market.
Adjusted the Season.
Added a Snowball Cannonball. (Freezes the player for 2.5 seconds with a 25% chance)
Blessing of the Depths has been added. (Gives 10,000 health and removes negative effects when used.)

notes.title: Version 2.8
notes.notes:
Added a 15-minute time limit to the Tortuga.
Fixed a speed stone display bug.
Added multiple logbooks to the login screen.
Added a limit on consecutive healing cannonball shots.
Updated the chat interface.
Added a timestamp to the rewards received in the logbook.
Increased daily login rewards.
Added the option to maximize or minimize the interface.
The Spy screen has been added to the Server dashboard tab.
Updated the Starter Pack.
Changed the location of the islands.
Added new Battle ships.
Added new Elite ships.
Changed Elite point rewards.
Added the ability to connect to the test server.
Added the Conqueror (1453) Event.

notes.title: Version 2.7
notes.notes:
Chat rules removed.
Ping viewing option added
Healing cannonball bug fixed.
NPC movement code edited.
Auction now shows remaining time in 1 minute intervals instead of 5 minutes.
Raid PVE - PVP players with last level elite points will not be able to enter.
When you enter the raid map, it is forbidden to leave the map for 15 seconds.
NPC counter added to the raid map.
King ship added to the market for new players. The ship has the features of a level 15 elite ship.
Shadow of Tortuga added. (If you break the invisibility with a cannonball, the cannonball you throw will deal 50% more damage)
Hell cannonball added.
Sengoku added. (World boss appears every 2 hours in one of the 1-10 maps.)
When new players register, 1 week premium will be added to their accounts as a gift.
Lion event added.
Some bugs fixed.

notes.title: Version 2.6
notes.notes:
Raid map pve npc health have been adjusted.
Fog has been adjusted.
Interface improvements have been made.
Tower damage has been increased.
Some game bugs have been closed.
Bone deck system has been added.
Blood Event has been added.

notes.title: Version 2.5
notes.notes:
Youtube ship effect added.
NPC lives on Maps 9-10 increased by 1.5 times.
Some textual errors fixed.
Some UI fixes made.
Ranks expanded.
Fog added.
Raid map (PVE) added.
Raid map (PVP) added.
Gold and Diamond packages edited.
King Event added.
Event ship elite point reward increased by 3 times.

notes.title: Version 2.4
notes.notes:
Base speed increased by 1.
King market packages have been adjusted.
Some bugs have been fixed
Ice rocket location on the phone interface has been changed.
Ice rocket auto-use feature has been added.
Anti-bot system has been improved.
Players with an elite level below 15 will earn 2 times more elite points from the materials they use.
Elite Points booster has been added.
The invisible spawning bug of the player ship has been fixed.
A special cannonball shooting effect has been added to the Flying Dutchman ship.
Venom event has been added.

notes.title: Version 2.3.1
notes.notes: Hot Fixes

notes.title: Version 2.3
notes.notes:
Server optimized.
Fixed text bug.
Added bonus map exit feature.
Increased skill save count from 3 to 4.
Reduced base speed by 1.
Added Flying Dutchman ship.
Added smoke effect to medal ships.
Event cannonball now gives 5 elite points instead of 4.
Medals of players with medals appear below the ship.
Added ice rocket. (Gives 5 elite points)
Added bone event.

notes.title: Verison 2.2
notes.notes:
Spy fee increased from 500 diamonds to 1000 diamonds.
Auction text error fixed.
Ship movement code edited.
Golden cannon added. (Will develop with development system)
Columbus event added.

notes.title: Version 2.1
notes.notes:
Fleet tower build code edited.
Healing cannonball added to the interface for mobile.
Battle rewards edited, elite points added.
Auto clicker blocking.
The amount of items taken from the bag was increased.
The exit time became 15 seconds from 20 seconds.
Pirate added.
The error of the text disappearing regarding the chat size was fixed.
Elite Ship visual error was fixed.
Speed ​​stone effect error was fixed.
Ice event added.

notes.title: Version 2.0
notes.notes:
Event calendar text error fixed.
Protected ship cannot throw bombs and is not damaged by bombs.
Protected ship cannot attack baron.
Chat-Bot system improved.
Gold error related to fleet bank fixed.
Chat size can be adjusted for computer.
Added ability to go to location after using spy.
Youtube ship added.
Elite ships added.

notes.title: Version 1.9
notes.notes:
Event cannonball text error fixed.
Kayra ship visual error fixed.
Daily bonuses added.
Talent loading error fixed.
Island towers attack speed changed from 3 seconds to 2.5 seconds.
Auction edited. (5 king coins, 20 kraken chests added and silver sail and mast removed)
Server optimized.
Fleet baron related error fixed.
Winter event added.
Bomb added.
Attack area added to interface.

notes.title: Version 1.8
notes.notes:
Fixed text bug.
The island will give a bonus if it has 12 towers.
A bug related to building towers has been fixed.
A new bonus map has been added (Gojo).
A feature has been added to bonus maps.
When the island is captured, it will come as 2 towers instead of 6.
A fleet baron has been added.
The compass will not show the location of the sunken player.
A new event has been added.

notes.title: Version 1.7
notes.notes:
Fixed text bug.
Bonus map added. (Maki map).
Added bonus map piece to Cursed Captain.
Added limit for taking islands. A fleet will have a maximum of 4 islands.

notes.title: Version 1.6
notes.notes:
Premium owners will receive 30% of the experience points.
The gold limit for the auction has increased, 9 steps can be bid.
Players' view range has changed, they now see a round area instead of a square.
A call for help has been added.
A compass has been added.
A new tab has been added for the bag.
When someone without a fleet sinks, they now give 1 battle point instead of 2.
Profile has been edited.
Interface has been edited.
Fleet tag and name change has been added. (Once a day)
The fleet leader will not have to leave the fleet to transfer the fleet leadership.
Server has been optimized.
Cursed Pirate has been added.
New ship has been added (Kayra).
It has been prevented from making the same bid as the bid in the auction.
Anti-bot system has been improved.

notes.title: Version 1.5
notes.notes:
Textual errors have been fixed.
The Stack button code part has been adjusted.
A feature to enlarge player names has been added.
Material prices have been updated.
A visual bug related to ships has been fixed.
Players without a fleet will now receive 2 battle points when they sink.
The server has been optimized.
Season rewards have been adjusted.
Rewards earned from missions will now affect the season ranking.
New data has been added to the profile.
The Halloween event has been added.
A bug related to map jumping has been fixed.
Two new items have been added to the auction.
The premium bonus bug has been fixed.

notes.title: Version 1.4.1
notes.notes:
Map jump bug fixes.
Hot fixes.

notes.title: Version 1.4
notes.notes:
Fixed the premium date text issue.
Elite classes now give 3 cannons per level instead of 2.
New elite ships have been added.
Fixed the bug where the ship was not visible after map jumping.
Fixed the issue where the ship appeared in a different location after map jumping.
Map jump duration reduced from 2 seconds to 1.5 seconds.
Ship movement code for mobile has been adjusted.
Iron cannonball damage reduced from 45 to 10.
Fire cannonball will deal 25% more damage to fleet towers.
Range items in the bag increased from 5 minutes to 15 minutes.
Protection item has been adjusted; it now provides protection up to the 5th map, and the cooldown is 4 hours.
Quick repair time reduced from 20 seconds to 15 seconds.
Premium repair amount increased by 1%.
Fixed the profile interface display issue.
Maps 9 and 10 have been added.
The feature to see all seas in blue color has been added.
Daily quest rewards have been increased.
Carnis fleet tower health reduced from 24M to 20M.
Carnis fleet tower cost increased from 6M to 9M.
Fleet tower construction time increased from 25 minutes to 30 minutes.
Players can now name the talent save page.
Stealing limit added: 25 steals per day.
When a player’s ship sinks, it will no longer automatically respawn after 10 seconds.
Added the ability to log in using a username or email.
New data has been added to the profile.
Gold, silver, and bronze ships have been adjusted.
The admiral’s damage in maps 1 and 2 has been reduced.
Fixed the issue where the ship appeared as "Tarsier" on iOS.
Event added.

notes.title: Version 1.3
notes.notes:
The issue where the Ares ship disappeared from the map has been fixed.
Map jump time has been set to 2 seconds.
Speed stone will now provide 25% speed instead of 50%.
Quick repair time has been increased from 10 seconds to 20 seconds.
Auto repair effectiveness has been reduced by 50%.
Range ability increased from 0.1 to 0.2.
Defense ability reduced from 100 to 50.
Defensive health reduced from 1000 to 500.
Critical damage increased from 2% to 4%.
Auto repair ability reduced from 0.002% to 0.001%.
Cannon range has been increased by 1 unit.
A spy shortcut has been added to the mini-map.
Player profiles will now be visible in the leaderboard.
Rank icons have been updated.
Healing cannonball attack power reduced from 20 to 5.
Healing cannonball can now only be used on allies.
Healing cannonball will no longer give elite points.
Admirals will only notify players in their current map.
A save system for abilities has been added.
In the seasonal quest, the number of quick repairs needed has been reduced from 5000 to 2500.
A joystick option or manual drag option has been added in the mobile settings.
Several textual errors have been fixed.
Multiple purchases for cannons, masts, and sails have been added to the market.
If a player is AFK and killed twice, they will be disconnected from the game.
On mobile, the area displaying cannon icons will now show the remaining ammunition.
Elite classes have been strengthened. Now, instead of 1 cannon per level, they will receive 3, along with an extra 100 rocket damage per level.
A special ship has been added for medals and achievements.
New maps 7 and 8 have been added.
You can now travel to a specific location by typing it on the map.

notes.title: Version 1.2
notes.notes:
Joystick added for mobile.
Mobile menu interface edited.
Anti-bot system improved.
Bug in name section fixed when creating a clan.
Skill interface edited.
Chat background edited.
Island bonuses will be visible in fleet page.
New key assignment feature added to CRTL key.
Stack key edited.
Lock added to computer menu hotbar.
New keys added to keyboard key menu.
Fleet name can have spaces.
Admiral counter on map increased to 300.
Announcement is made when Admiral appears.
Safe map admirals have reduced their health.
High level players cannot attack safe map admirals.
Admiral will spawn in the location of last killed NPC.
Automatic rocket added.
Automatic attack edited.
Interface edited for computer.
4 seconds time added for map jumping.
Stacking made easier on mobile.
Fleet island sizes reduced.
Fleet islands strengthened.
Calendar added to fleet logbook.
Fleet towers attack mechanism has changed. 
Fleet experience ranking has been added.
Removed water appearing when hitting a fleet tower.
Fixed a textual bug related to the registration date.
Fleet diplomacy has been edited.
Edited the location code where the player spawns after sinking.
Ares attack mechanism has been edited.
Added a detection system related to emulators.
Reduced the healing cannonball in season missions from 10,000 to 2,500.
Fixed a textual error that showed the same damage twice.
The map where you received the daily mission will be visible on the mission board.
Added spy.

notes.title: Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Admiras' health increased.
Admiral counter decreased from 300 to 200.
Value of all chests increased by 2 times.
Negative health will not come out of fortune chest.
12-hour text in daily mission fixed.
Shield icon was displayed when NPC was damaged fixed.
Chat became level 2 instead of level 3.
Admiral will be Orange on mini map.
Ships turning upside down issue fixed.
Interface will not close while developing skills.
Bot control spawn time extended.
Bot control numbers decreased from 4 digits to 3 digits.
3. Map NPC will not be stolen.
Text errors fixed.
Space issue fixed while entering code.
Added that if you click on the target by clicking the left CTRL key, it will go right to it.
Quick repair became gold instead of diamonds.
Fleet-creating costs increased from 2000 diamonds to 10,000 diamonds.
NPC range decreased.
Fixed the issue where the ship would move while writing in chat.
Fixed the issue where battle points would not be gained.
Range skill will give 1 range instead of 0.5 range.
Healing cannonball will not be spent on a player with full health.
Single cannon shooting disabled.
Quick repair and Speed ​​stone usage bug fixed.
Admiral spawning in wrong location fixed.
Market prices adjusted, reduced by 3-5 times.
Gold and diamond package added.
Textual error regarding fleet book fixed.
Event added.
